[b][u]Lavian International news[/u][/b]

[u][nation]BR Bob[/nation] Military exports:[/u]

The Bobian Military has recently purchased two infantry and one calvary hulls of the Modular Armored Vehicle Hull #15 (MAVH-15) to be tested in their own field trials. The cheap and rugged vehicle and it's variants have served in militaries all over the world for 36 years now, serving in all types of roles. These hulls will be delivered without turrets, and experts assume that the Bobian military will attempt to modify existing turrets from current vehicles to fit the MAVH-15. Presumably these are to help bolster the nations defensive capabilities and provide a substitute vehicle for the country's national guard, allowing cutting edge vehicles to be mainly used by the active military. While this does sound like the MAVH-15 chassis is out of style, it's far from it. Modernization procedures and it's great design keeps it capable of knocking out tanks, providing infantry support, and doing all of its jobs on the modern battlefield. As more info come out, our correspondents from the Lavian and Bobian militaries will keep us updated. To see more information on the MAVH-15, please feel free to visit the nonprofit information website of ULRMilitaryHistory.org.

[u]The Royal International Artifacts Museum receives items saved from the Second Flousech Republic ([nation]skullsbrough[/nation]):[/u]

Recently, the Royal International Artifacts Museum has received various paintings, pieces of stone masonry, and even massive stained glass windows from the revolutionary state. While more shipments are reportedly incoming, rumors have spread that the Historic Conservation Commission (HCC) paid various sums of money to bureaucrats and security officials to package and ship these artifacts back to Lavia before the century old palaces and churches of Flousech are demolished by the new communist government. These demolitions are apparently due to the buildings "representing the Monarchy as above the common man," and the elegant structures will be replaced by brutalist and modernist buildings. Some anticipated arrivals to the Artifacts Museum are multiple stained glass pieces from churches all around the country, almost half of the portraits of past monarchs, and some rumors even include the king's throne itself. Another rumored arrival are a selection of rare cars from the country, said to be purchased specifically by King Herman III himself for his own automobile museum and collection.

[b][u]Hydronian Military Replenishment Deal [/u][/b]

[b]Vehicle Purchase Section[/b]

1.a: The ULR agrees to sell 6 frigates, 2 cruisers, 2 Chimera 6000N aircraft, and 4 Chimera 6000S aircraft.

1.b: Lavia will deliver these vehicles within the time limit of one month after the deal is signed.

1.c: Lavia will allow Hydronia to buy replacement parts, ammunition, as well as acquire training for the vehicle's crew and maintenance technicians for as long as Hydronia keeps current with their payments and neither states break any other part of the trade deal. 

1.d: The ships that will be sold are as follows: The cruisers ULS Hannigan and ULS Warfeild, along with the frigates ULS Orbson, ULS Valli, ULS Carter, ULS Belafonte, ULS Douglass, and ULS Croce. 

2.a: Hydronia will pay the ULR the equivalent of $450,000,000 in either reserve currency, strategic resources, other exports, or gold.

2.b: Hydronia will not be able to sell, donate, or otherwise allow any nation to operate the naval assets outlined in this deal by any nation outside of THEP or the EEHP, and will not allow the nuclear air assets outlined in this deal to be sold, donated, or otherwise allow any nation to operate such assets outside the EEHP.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[b]Resource Section[/b]

3.a: Hydronia opens its resource market for Lithium and Uranium to Lavia for purchase by private firms or the Lavian government.

3.b: Lavia will open it's resource market for Copper and Gold to Hydronia for purchase by private firms or the Hydronian government.

3.c: The Value of the Lithium and Uranium will be based on global market prices, ensuring purchases are fair and prices adjust to market demand and supply.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[spoiler=No other governments know of this part!]
[b]Captured vehicles Section[/b]
4.a: As part of paying the cost of the vehicles purchased, Hydronia will provide Lavia with one MBT, one AFV, and one wheeled armored vehicle from the Technokratisches Kaiserreich.

4.b: Lavia will have full ownership of these vehicles once provided, free to destroy them or put them in museums.

4.c: Lavia will share all information found with the Hydronian military in assist against the Kaiserreich.
[/spoiler]

[spoiler=The joining of Nordiheim and Datia]
[b][u]Chapter 1:[/u][/b]
[b]About the past and how the prosses started.[/b]
The Republic of Datia is a small but well populated little nation that was formed beside Aboria region and south of the Ostland region of Nordiheim all the way back in the 1600s by the Aboriginals that lived there, though they have a far longer history when it comes to the people of Aboria as they have traded and interacted with eachother as if family before nordiheim even welcomed Aboria as the newest of its regions all the way back in 979 AD, though back then the Datia people was not interested in joining their fellow Aboriginals as they found the Norse decended Nordiheimians to be a bit voilent for their taste.

But that attitude started to change in the early 1700s when Nordiheim was attacked by the Holy Hydronic Empire in [i]The Long War of Continuation[/i] and they saw that the Nordiheimians was far from the most violent people out there in the vider world and that they had been lucky that not a more imperialistic group of people had come to the continent they called home, because of this the cultures of Nordiheim and Datia started to mix more freely then before allowing their languages to become more similar and even saw the Datians adopting a similar naming practices when it came to last names, someting that they diden't realy have before that.

By the 1900s the Datian people no longer viewed the Nordiheimians as a violent people anymore, but rather as fellow Argosians, and the first discussions started among the people of the small republic if they would not be bether off if they joined their Aborian brethren as a part of  Nordiheim.
These discussions was also greatly helped and accelerated by the growing corruption among the majority of the upper elite of their nation who were suspected of rigging the elections to get their people and family members into possitions of power and then direct the nations funds toward projects and contracts that either put money into their pockets or that benefited their own people even when it was painfully obvious that it was not the best choice for the nation.

These elites was not interested in joining Nordiheim as they would not only lose all their power but also most likely be put on trial for corruption and criminal activities, as such they used their power to block or deny any and all atempts to call for a vote on the subject.
That took an abrupt change in Datias 2016 presidental election were the people almoust out of no were paraded their vote out in the open to make it imposible for the elite to rig the election as they usualy did.
They achived this by using one of the very few national projects that had actually been mutualy beneficial for the whole nation called "The Datian Ethernet project" wich had made the internet of the country one of the best at the time, this project had originaly been done to allow the elite bether access to information and make controll over the population easier, but unfortunatly the people had learned how to use and exploit its advantages far faster then the elites were able to.
And they had not only used this to inform and comunicate the idea of as many as posible to do their vote as an open one, but also spread it live on TV and as many social media platforms as they could while blocking the henchmen of the elite from stopping it from being shown.

This allowed them to vote a man named Warrin Nullah'Kardu, that had been campaigning on a platform of imidate vote on the subject of joining Nordiheim, into the position of president were he could insert more trusted and uncorupted people into what was now HIS office.
The elite of course tried to stop this with large atempts at vote riging and social attacks and claims of Warrin being a fraud, but it could not be undone, when all the live votes had been counted Mr Warrin had enough votes to make up 69% of the entire voting population wich was unrefutable proof that he had won.
In adition the council of Nordiheim at the time also declared that they would immidiatly interfere with military force if the result was not honered, as they had been waiting on such a oportunity for some time.

And as he had said in his campaign, the now President Warrin Nullah'Kardu, declared that there would be a vote for wether or not they would become a part of Nordiheim or remain a independant nation, someting that would sett ireversable tings in motion.
By late 2016 the people cast their vote on the subject, ones more many chose to do their vote publicly, and while the elite tried to desperatly rig the vote they could not grasp back controll from the people who now came out in their entierty to do one of their most important votes in their generation.
When the year truned into 2017 the result was anounced: 52% in favor for joining Nordiheim ageinst 41% ageinst it, and 7% neutral.
Naturaly the amount of votes did not add up with over 3 million votes, more then there was people in the nation, but the public votes made the Yes sides result look far more legitemate.
Besides the law did not actually care about such things, it only needed the wining vote to achive two requirements:
-Have the most amounts of votes
-And be atleast 50% of the tottal votes
As such President Warrin Nullah'Kardu could lawfully ask the council of Nordiheim to allow their nation of Datia to become one with Nordiheim, peticulary so that their people could be a part of the Aboria region, this of course was quickly acepted.

[b]A short but important civil war - 2017.[/b]
The elites tough would not go out without a fight as they used their conections and generous bribes to gather a sizable part of the army under their command, with this they tried to strike a quick military coup on the 7th of march 2017 by attacking the capitol city of Mparntwe from the south-east.
This did not go to plan however, as the day before the attack a unkown insider among the military personell they had comandeered warned the legal goverment wich allowed them to gather the local soldiers that remained loyal to defend the capitol and buy time for them to ask for immidiate military intervention from Nordiheim.
And with thousands of civilian people joining them as militias they did manage to buy the time that was needed.

On the 8th of march Nordiheim declared that they sided with president Warrin Nullah'Kardu and his legaly elected goverment and start their military attacks ageinst the Datian elites military forces on the same day.
While it had been known that military forces of Datia had been rather out-dated it would quickly become apparent that the coruption perpetrated by the now rebeling elites actually ran deeper then imagined and had actually rendered the military almoust useless ageinst a force that used modern warfare.
The airforce was grounded in less then 2 days with joust missiles and the few modern-ish anti-air defences that they had was rendered useless the day after leaving them with only some old anti-air guns and cannons from the 50s.
The ground army did not fair mutch better as they were forced to end their attack on the capitol after less then a week as they were geting cut of from and form of logistics lines and suport by rapidly deployed 'Vanguard units' deployed from Aborias local military bases.
The now dominating Nordiheimian airforce could fly freely in Datias sky and pick the fleeing ground forces appart with impunity until they managed to reach the 3 largest cities in the south and south-east of Datia, there they hid their forces among the civilian buildings while activly stoping the citicens from leaving, since the Nordiheimian military was not allowed to shoot at civilians if there was another way (they were going to become official Nordiheimians at some point after all) wich allowed the elites and their remaining ground forces to drag the now fully official civil war into a longer affair.

The parts of Datias military that was fighting for the elected goverment was quickly suplied weapons and equipment by the Nordiheimians so that they could fight side-by-side with them as the ground campaign of the civil war was started in full agienst the 3 cities that had made into their strongholds.
These were the North-west city of Malanda and the northern cities of Allawah and Balga.
The city of Balga who was the closest to Nordiheim was the first to be surrounded and would surender after only a month with not a lot of actual fighting taking place, this was because it became apparent realy quickly that they had low moral and all that was needed was pantience for the soldiers there to surender or return to the folds of Datias republican army.
Malanda took a bit longer with about 3 months of fighting before the remaining troops there raised thewhite flagg, thankfully the damages to the city and its people were managed to be cept low.
Allawah on the other hand turned into a far longer and bloodier siege, taking as long as 7 months before they finnaly surendered, this was caused be multible factors such as it having ended up with not only the largest part of the rebel armie but also many of the more dedicated people of the elite including their own private soldiers.

By late october 2017 the civil war was more or less over with only a few pockets and induvitual to clean up, most of the Datian elite was either dead or captured, including the defacto leader of the elite Mr. Warragul Antakari'Kardu.
A long legal prosses was put in motion to judge them not only for their atempted coup but also for their many acts of corruption and potential crimes, most were given long jail sentences with the exeption of Warragul Antakari'Kardu who was sentenced to execution by hanging for being behind not only the coup that led to the civil war but also some of the most severe cases of crime and corruption, he was hanged on the 7th of april 2022.

With the power finnaly being fully in the hands of the Datian people for the first time in over a century the prosses of becoming a part of Nordiheim could begin.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[u][b]Chapter 2:[/b][/u] 
[b]Rebuilding and the integration planing 2018:[/b]
While the rebuilding of Datia, mostly in the capitol city Mparntwe and the secound largest city Allawah, did not take to long with aid and investment from the larger economy of Nordiheim but the integration prosses would take much longer.
It would internaly start in both nation as early as 2018 with the bureaucratic part and a full census of the actual population in Datia, this was someting that would be rather usefull latter, there would also be made plans and sett up projects to address the many problems found around Datia, with the overpupulation and extreeme lack of housing, especialy in the cities, needing to be addressed as the price for even a tiny appartment was 20 times the average Datians yearly sallary, wich ment many of them could only afford to rent places as large groups.
A full investigation would also be done to help see what condition the local ecconomy, industry, military and infastructure  was actually in aswell as find what was needed to be done to get it all up to Nordiheim standard.

The ecconomy was in a rather precarious condition as it was found to actually be dangerously close to falling appart, the corruption had focused much of it into parts that was controlled by the elites while almoust compleatly ignoring the rest, as such it stood on only tree industries wich was the unique Datian silk, its agriculture that was rather monocultured with wheat, barley and cotton, and the IT Industry that had stopped it from falling appart sooner.
It was desided to start work to diversifying it by diversifying its agriculture with more types of crops and propper crop rotations but also to find out what types of ellements it was running low on to stop the earth from suffering from nutrient based soil degradation, wich it was showing the early warning signs off, aswell improving the Datian silk industry by starting up a manufacturing industry to make silk clothes and products to stop it from being purely a extraction based sector.
Geological surveys would also be done in Datia to see if there was other tings to make industries from as the bedrock was pretty much the same as Aboria wich held the possibility of veins or deposits of ores and presious stones.
The only industry that diden't realy need a lot of investment was the newer IT industry wich was going strong and still growing, with a significat portion of it being allready hired by different industrial sectors in Nordiheim, though it would still be worth it to invest in it for greater use in the rest of Nordiheim as it was a sector that they actually were lacking inn.

Allmoust all of the infrastructure of Datia was in dire straights with the exeption of the places that had been controlled by the former elites of the small nation and the internet "backbone", infact the internet infrastucture was rather impressive with strong servers, fiber optic cables, NAPs, IXPs and even some data centers with the main one in the capitol being the most impresive.
The Nordiheimian council, and their different team of advisors, experts and aids, was slightly baffeled by how advanced it actually was as it could easely be said to be bether then what Nordiheim had, so it was decided to take notes on it and hire the many workers and proffesionals that Datia had ended up with when constructing it all start working on Nordiheims internet "backbone" to get it to the same level or bether then what Datia had, this would not only provide work for them but also help Nordiheim in the future even tough they diden't know it yet.
The rest of the infrastucture was going to need a lot of work to improve, be it roads, electrical grid, railroads and public services like hospitals, fire departments and police.

The railroad was peticularly a bit weird as it was a different gauge then what Nordiheim was using with the exeption of the main line from Ngura to the capitol Mparntwe, this would have to be changed of course, though some of the old train tracks could be reused to cut down on cost and time, to plan and execute this they gathered the railroad workers of Datia to both collect information and organize it.
The Datian railroad workers would not only provide a lot of good information about what could be reused and what should be fully replaced but also what part of the documents and plans that had been replaced to Nordiheim was actually correct, as not all of it was.
One ting that wasn't correct, to the confusion of the Nordiheimians, was the fact that the railroad track to the city of Ngarakaya in the north had never been completed, wich was rather weird as it was the city with the largest silk production by a large margine, the workes explained that the project had been plauged by corruption and basicly sabotage by the people that had been put in charge by the elites at the time as they wanted the silk production in Malanda to be prioretised as it was owned by family members of Mr. Warragul Antakari'Kardu.
It was decided that this would not do and that a railroad to Ngarakaya would be one of the first projects started together with a large new railroad that would be constructed trough the jungle from west and west-central Ostland to create shorter train conections to the large harbors of Ostland. 

There would also be planed and launched projects to improve and upgrade the roads in Datia aswell as the electrical grid wich did not reach all towns and settlements, having been focused mostly on for the larger cities that most elites had lived inn.
The fire departments and the police of Datia would not be to hard to upgrade as there were many Datians working as police officers and fire fighters that was eager to finaly do their nobs propperly now that they diden't have corupt bosses or the thugs of the elite blocking their work, all they realy needed was new and bether equipment and vehicles for the most part wich would not be difficult to provide from Nordiheims vehicle industry.
The hospitals would need more work tough as they needed more then joust new abulances, their buildings were old and their equipment outdated and relied extreemly heavely on the experience and ability of the doctors and nurses to even function, and they did deliver on that, but new equipment and access to bether suplies and medicine would make their jobs far easier, but they would need training in how to use them propperly wich would take a few years to come to fruition.

The public services would also have to be propperly integrated into the internet and telecomunication grid, someting they had not been, most likely this was done as a safe guard by the elites as a "joust in case" ting, as such the hospitals, fire departments, police stations and goverement offices could not easely comunicate with each other, President Warrin Nullah'Kardu had even told them that some had to do it verbaly face-to-face, this not only had to be fixed but all of it also had to be integrated into the rest of Nordiheims network as well, someting that would proberly be what would take the longest of all the work that needed to be done in Datia for the integration to be done propperly.

Then of course there was the old and outdated Datian military, much of their vehicles and equipment was only valuable as scrap metal while other parts of it was basicly junk, there proberly wasn't even nations out there willing to buy the stuff at scrap metal prices.
Luckely tough the Nordiheimans did not need the Datian military, the troops that had fought ageinst the rebels had been allready equiped with Nordiheimian guns and equipment and there wasn't exactly like Nordiheims military was lacking in vehicles and weapons.
As such it was quickly decided that all the old vehicles, weapons and equipment of the Datian military would be sendt to scrap yards and recycling plants, together with the wrecks that littered the areas the civil war had been fought in, so that the metal and materials could be recycled as well as possible.

The land of Datia would also be splitt up, someting the Datians had thankfully agreed to after some writhen, and binding, promisses, the northern parts was very sparsly populated and mostly covered in jungle with the exeption of the long strip of land that streched all the way north-east to the sea and the ancient fort of Bjargvirki.
The long strip of land that reached the ocean had been striped off jungel about 70 years ago to make way for railroad tracks that went to the Ostland port city of Berghavn with the intention to enable easier transport of Datian silk and agrecultural products, but it had not worked as not only had that also been suffered from corruption but the ground there had shown itself to be ill suited for someting as heavy as trains to travel over it in many places, wich had led to several accidents and colapses of the railroad tracks until it was eventualy abandoned entierly because of the ever increasing costs, now nature was well on its way to re-counqering it.
The ancient fort of Bjargvirki had actually been part of Nordiheim for some time having been built back in 991 AD to be used as a hidden staging point for the war ageinst the golden nobles of Ostland and then later heavely upgraded and reiforced for use ageinst the Holy Hydronic Empire when they tried to invade Nordland back in the early 1700s, but in 1801 it was given to The Republic of Datia as a gift, now it would become a part of Nordiheim ones more and it would be upgraded ones more to as it would be made into a strategic SAM site to give protection to the the northern area of Nordiheim aswell as the railroad network that would be constructed to go past it.

This long strip of land together with the rest of the northern part would become part of the Ostland region and its jungel zone.
The rest of Datia, were over 95% of the population lived, would of course become part of Aboria and be allowed to start moving out into the rest of the region to address the housing crisis in Datia but also help the Aborian housing market as there was so few people there that houses and propperty was not worth much, tough it would have to be done with close supervision to avoid any city or area in Datia from suffering work force collapse.

With plans laid down and projects pilling up the prosses would get underway, it would be some buisy years for many parts of the Nordiheimian goverment aswell as the civilian industrial sector, but it would all be worth it when it was done and the Datians would become fellow Nordiheimian brothers and sisters under the same banner.

[b][u]Chapter 3:[/u][/b]
[b]Virus dying down and the official announcement - 2025[/b]
The lyondar virus had caused quite the stir when it had reached the people of Datia and unfortunaly been able to spread to many people and kill far to many of them, leaving empty seats at many dinner tables, but after first getting the antibodies injection distributed and not to long after that the vaccine, it only took about two weeks for the situation to change compleatly and the viruses deadly visit to Datia had been pretty much stoped.
Some patients still remained but their life was no longer under treath being ended by the virus as they were given antibodies injections when ever needed, as such the number of dead would not rise any higher.
While the number of infected could not yet be given a sett number, being over four hundred thousand bythe latest numbers, the dead could be given a exact number, 217'955 people had been lost in Datia, together with the people killed in the short civil war the twenty-first century would easely be the dealiest century in their entire recorded history and had reduced them from almoust 2'500'000 people down to only about 2'100'000, a number they were able to know because of the extensive population survey that had been thankfully been done in the 2018-2020 period.
Luckely the Datians were pragmatic about the whole event and was looking at the future with hope that things would become bether in the future.
They were also thankfull that the Nordiheimian council had acted quickly when they had been told about how bad tings had actually gotten in Datia, if anyting the only ones they blamed was them self for not agreeing to thell Nordiheim sooner, apparently they had thought that they would be able to handle it themself and prove that they were not compleatly dependant on the council and people of Nordiheim to do things wich turned out to be a rather bad idea, they now saw that mutual cooperation was a much bether idea.

Though there were some brighter sides to the wider lockdown that the virus had casued, and that was that some projects could actually be done faster such as the upgrade and conversion of the railroad tracks that conected the different parts of Datia to eachother and the rest of Nordiheim since the traffic on them was drasticaly reduced.
This together with the new and almoust compleat railroad track going north up to the old but progressivle upgraded and improved fort of Bjargvirki, were it split into one line going straight north and another going north-west for bether and faster conection to the Ostland harbor cities of Hedeby and Huldrvik, ment that the railroad system as a whole were nearing compleation.

And there was also the sudden new vote that had been done through use of online voting, a rather impressive feat actualy as they had done a lot of work to make sure that is was secure from cheating or double voting, this vote had showed what was belived to be a more true picture of how many Datians actualy agreed to Datia joining the larger nation of Nordiheim with 71% voting in favor of it while 16% was ageinst it and 13% as neutral.
Some saw it as an important vote as it symbolicly threw away the last large stain that the corrupted elites had tried to shackle Datia with.

Many other projects and jobbs had also been compleated like the modernization and upgrades to the fire departments, police systems/stations and the road network.
Tough as it had become painfully apparent the Hospitals had not been fully upgraded and modernized, and the internal comunication network between them and the local Datian, and wider Aborian, goverment departments was still lacking, tough it would hopefully be fully done before the year was ower.
The Datian military had also been rearanged and modernized with most of the old vehicles, weapons and equiplent had also been processed and transporte to recycling plants in Midland and Vestland, with only about 10% being left to move, were the work of breaking and melting it all down into usable metals were well underway.
The retrained and reorganized military of Datia was now part of the Nordiheimian army with its base being the Aborian command region, many of the soldiers had been trained by the Aborians Jungel and Ranger forces in how to fight in jungels and savanas and take advantage of old, but well tested, tactics of using the tools that nature provided for those that knew were to look.
As such the Datian soldiers were among the first to see the name of Datia as more of a definition of what part of Aboria they were from then a nationality, as they had become true brothers of their now fellow Aborian soldiers through both the training and integration but also the fighting they did together with them in the short 7 month long Datian civil war.

The geological tests of Datias bedrock had also turned up some interesting finds, while there were evidence that there was potential for smaller deposits of preciouse stones of the same type found in Aboria, there was one find that was more then joust a potential and that was the discovery of large deposits and veins of Nickel-Cobaltite between the cities of  Mparntwe and Malanda.
This discovery allready had people in the goverment making plans to establish a Datian/Aborian mining company to start mining the ore not only to strenghten the local economy but also give Nordiheim access to Cobalt and  Nickel pluss the other metals and minerals that could potentialy be extracted from this ore.
